name: memhub
description: XTrace MemHub team memory in Cursor: search_memory / save_artifact / import_conversation tools plus skills for setup, login, onboarding, artifact upload, session import, recall, handoff, spec-driven development, Rulebook rule authoring (create-rule) and a team's first Rulebook — tested starter rules fitted to the repo, and rules proposed from CLAUDE.md + past sessions, each filed with its categories and how many past sessions it would have fired in (start-rulebook), and PR babysitting. A rule is filed into a scope — everyone in the organisation (the default), just you, or a workspace you name — and reaches exactly those people. Sessions are captured automatically. Session ↔ PR linking ships as skills on Cursor: link-pr and find-contributing-sessions. Cursor's shell hooks are observational — `afterShellExecution` defines no reply the agent can see — so the automatic post-`gh pr create` link that Claude Code and Codex get is not available here. The agent records ONE work type for a pull request it links (feat, fix, chore, docs, perf, refactor, other), and only when the PR has none yet — the first label is permanent, and asking again would cost the link, not just the type. Spec workflows: spec-work guides implementation, spec-check freshly reviews changes, and spec-maintain offers local/cloud bootstrap and reviewable Git or Brain proposals through the shared spec entry point. A companion animal draws what the plugin is doing in the band above the prompt, one per session picked from its session id (/goose, /hippo, /penguin and /shiba switch it for the session; `always` pins one for every session): asleep while the session is idle, awake and watching while Claude answers or the person types, and up announcing each Rulebook rule that fires — crossly when one blocked the call — or presenting a rule the harness just proposed with Activate / Reject / Later buttons (activating takes an org admin, or you for a rule that applies to just you; the animal says so to anyone else). Clicking the ♥ beside it pets it, and a proposal's rule↗ opens that rule in MemHub Studio. It is a Claude Code mod, and mods are on by default from Claude Code 2.1.287 (the desktop Code tab from 2.1.286), so it loads with the plugin with nothing to turn on — the old CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS variable is ignored; disableAllHooks, --safe-mode, an organization policy or Anthropic switching mods off remotely stops it. /memhub:companion checks that and shows or hides it.
